description: This file defines the DefaultPublicHealthConfig class, which implements the PublicHealthConfig interface. It provides configuration settings related to the public health endpoint, primarily managing cache timeout durations based on provided configurations.

classes.name: DefaultPublicHealthConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing PublicHealthConfig interface, representing configuration settings for public health endpoint, including cache timeout.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of DefaultPublicHealthConfig based on a given Config object.

methods.name: getCacheTimeout
methods.description: Returns the configured cache timeout duration.
